title: The datacentre next door: residents challenge Britain's AI infrastructure boom
extract: Across Newport and Cardiff, residents are challenging plans for large AI and cloud datacentres over noise, air pollution, grid capacity and the loss of public amenities. The investigation describes how hundreds of proposed UK facilities could demand more electricity than the country typically uses at peak, and asks who benefits from the expansion of private computing infrastructure.

title: From Fatherland to Aberfan: the week's standout film, TV and book reviews
extract: The Guardian's weekly culture roundup highlights a historical drama about Thomas Mann's daughter and a documentary revisiting the Aberfan disaster, alongside recommendations spanning film, television, books and music. Its picks include the new Shaun the Sheep film and several literary works, offering a compact guide to recent releases across the arts.
